== Source history ==
The Decipher website image preserved in the 17 August 2001 capture prints “at related sites” in Artoo’s second ability.<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20010817020224id_/http://decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/jabbaspalace/light/images/artoo.gif Complete Decipher website image], 17 August 2001 capture.</ref> The 350 × 490 GIF shows the same website-text variant. The complete physical card prints “at same and related sites.”<ref>[[:File:JP-L-artoo-hires.webp|Complete physical Artoo scan]].</ref> Decipher’s November 1998 Glossary entry also retains “at same and related sites” within its clarified wording.<ref>[[Media:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Glossary Version 2.0]], p. 14, Artoo.</ref> The printed-original article uses the physical scan, and this website image remains preserved as a separate source asset.
